what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3584 Ethiopian refugees in Canada, 2.2% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia from 1989 to 1991 and from 2020 to 2022.
It also records armed conflicts over Oromiya and Ogaden territory in periods from 1989 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at its highest figure, 7786 refugees, and fell to a low in 2022.
It then rose again; the main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 1995 and 2005 to 2006.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
